describe.description: A large standing creature is shown in strict right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. The forward and dorsal two-thirds is that of a brown eagle: the head has a hooked beak yellow at the base and dark gray-black at the tip, a yellow cere, and a large amber-brown eye; the head, neck, chest, back, folded wings and upper legs are covered in dense overlapping brown feathers varying from golden-brown to dark brown with darker feather tips. Two thick feathered legs support the body and end in large yellow scaly feet with long curved black talons. At the rear, where a bird's rectrices would be, there is no feathered tail; instead a cluster of thick fleshy brown tentacles with rows of circular suckers hangs down and curls at the tips. Similar pale circular sucker-like bumps are visible on the skin of the thighs and shins beneath the leg feathers.

describe.description: A large standing bird of prey shown in right-facing profile with the head, feathering, wings, legs and taloned feet of a brown eagle, but with a cluster of long octopus-like tentacles bearing suckers hanging down from the rear where a tail would be. The plumage is dense golden-brown on the head and neck and darker layered brown on the folded wings and body, the legs are feathered to the yellow scaly feet, and pale circular suckers are also visible in patches on the lower belly and thighs.
